conversation tricks that quietly
get you what you want

1. use their name once

it makes people listen.

2. ask for advice, not a favour

people help those they've advised.

3. always have something
interesting to say
slides.texte_sophia:
3. always have something interesting
to say. i learn one thing a day on
an app like Sophia.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. pause after your question

let the silence work.
5. start with what you agree on

6. end on a high note

people remember the end most.

save this before your
next meeting
